letterText:
Happy Birthday, Ate Wenn! 💗

May your new year of life be filled with gentle blessings, beautiful beginnings, good health, and all the happiness your heart can hold. Like a butterfly, may you keep growing into wonderful new things; like a flower, may you always find ways to bloom.

Thank you for being such an awesome daughter, sister and aunt to your family. May today remind you how loved and appreciated you are.

Wishing you a magical birthday and a year full of reasons to smile!

With lots of love,
Angel, Claire, Raph and Dylan 🦋🌷
